issues.reason: Core patterns' projection rule puts a definite participant's presupposed material outside a strength-0 (And ...) denial — only the event class and role atoms stay inside — and (Possession sk_charges_1 sec) restricts the presupposed definite 'the SEC charges' rather than being part of what is denied, so as written nothing in the KB records the relation and the denial's scope wrongly covers it.

gaps_confirmed: no licensed attachment head for a proper-noun modifier on a common noun ('the SEC charges') — Compound concepts is barred for proper nouns and the genitive rule needs 's / a possessive pronoun / an of-phrase
a sentence-initial frame adverbial ('For legal purposes, ...') has only the event-level oblique to attach to, so it lands inside the strength-0 denial and reads as denied content
new_gaps: the projection rule names only the definite's Member / Name / GroupOf typing atom; it says nothing about a definite's non-typing restrictor (here the Possession link), which is exactly what this parse turned on
repair_summary: Lifted (Possession sk_charges_1 sec) out of the four strength-0 bundles into one top-level atom (td57_charges_sec) beside the projected group typing; the four denial bundles are otherwise unchanged.
notes: The improvised Possession head itself is acceptable gap-territory improvisation — Possession is opaque and covers loose association — so the repair relocates it rather than removing it. 'Neither ... nor' over a distributive coordinated subject correctly yields four strength-0 bundles.
